scholarships.title: The Singapore Police Force Scholarship
scholarships.official_source: Public Service Commission and Singapore Police Force

existing.description: The Singapore Police Force Scholarship is a uniformed scholarship offered jointly by the Public Service Commission and the Singapore Police Force, described on the official page as 'one of the most prestigious scholarships awarded by the Public Service Commission'. It is awarded to candidates with outstanding leadership qualities, impeccable integrity and a strong interest in policing. It pays tuition fees and other approved charges, a monthly maintenance allowance including accommodation, a pre-studies allowance, return economy class airfare for overseas study, National Service disruption support and a full salary including bonuses for the duration of studies, against a bond of four to six years.
eligibility: Keen interest in serving in the Singapore Police Force
Outstanding academic and Co-Curricular Activity (CCA) records
GCE A-Levels, International Baccalaureate, Polytechnic, NUS High School or other high school diploma/certificate
existing.eligibility_summary: Singapore Citizen with strong leadership qualities and potential, a keen interest in serving in the Singapore Police Force, outstanding academic and co-curricular activity records, a GCE A-Level, International Baccalaureate, Polytechnic, NUS High School or other high school diploma or certificate, and the ability to excel in Officer Cadet School. All MHA scholarships are open to male and female applicants.
benefits: Tuition fees and other approved charges
Monthly overseas or local maintenance allowance (including accommodation)
Pre-studies allowance e.g. settling in, warm clothing, computer
Return economy class airfare if studying overseas
Sponsorship of Master's and exchange programmes if requirements are met
Full salary for the duration of your studies including bonuses
coverage: Tuition fees and other approved charges
Monthly overseas or local maintenance allowance (including accommodation)
Pre-studies allowance e.g. settling in, warm clothing, computer
Return economy class airfare (if studying overseas)
Full salary for the duration of your studies (including bonuses)
Sponsorship of Master's and exchange programmes (if requirements are met)
requirements: Female applicants must submit earlier to have enough time to prepare for enlistment into Basic Military Training
Study at a local or overseas university in most disciplines except medicine, dentistry and architecture
Law degree holders will not be called to the Bar while serving in SPF
Be assigned to a uniformed career track in the Singapore Police Force
application_method: Follow the MHA Scholarships application process at https://www.mha.gov.sg/careers/mha-scholarships/
Submit through the Public Service Commission scholarship portal at https://www.psc.gov.sg/scholarships/apply-for-scholarship/psc-scholarships/
existing.selection_notes: Awarded to candidates who have shown outstanding leadership qualities, possess impeccable integrity and have a strong interest in policing work to safeguard the nation. In the first 6 years of career, scholars are rotated through regular postings to acquire investigation acumen, policy conceptualisation skills and command and leadership abilities.
existing.best_fit: Singapore citizen school leavers with strong academic and co-curricular records who intend to serve as a uniformed police officer and can meet Officer Cadet School entry requirements.
existing.duration: Full-time undergraduate degree; bond of 4 years for local studies, 5 years for studies in non-English speaking countries and 6 years for studies in English speaking countries
existing.application_period: Applications for the 2027 intake are open until 15 March 2027; female applicants are advised to submit earlier to allow time for Basic Military Training
existing.program_type: Uniformed public service undergraduate scholarship for the Singapore Police Force
